text: Steenbarger: with W swing LH/LL there is no established higher-timeframe trend, so this is not a C2 retracement in a trend; it is a daily pause (D close_vs_swing_high_pct 3.4, D swing HH but LL), valid only as a short trade measured in bars (C18), horizon 10 sessions at most. in_zone:ma_20 is a zone, not a trigger; I object to it as written. The ticket should adopt Wyckoff's clearing condition: h1_close_above:bar_high on H1 after a pullback that holds structure_shift_ref. Wrong if a daily close below fib_618. Lowest conviction of my supports.
